sentences.en: And it seems like even on the night of that victory, you start to confront those who are skeptical of you and who you want to win over.
sentences.zh: 看来即使在获胜的那晚，你也开始面对那些对你持怀疑态度，而你又想争取的人了。

sentences.en: And since we were just talking about police, let's talk about what you have said since the primary victory.
sentences.zh: 既然我们刚才谈到了警察，那我们就聊聊你在初选获胜后所说的话吧。

sentences.en: I think it was actually at the Times where my colleagues asked you about how you're going to be thinking about the police.
sentences.zh: 我想当时是在《泰晤士报》，我的同事问你打算如何看待警察问题。

sentences.en: And I was struck that you said you were prepared to apologize to the NYPD for some of the things you had said, defund the allegation that the department is raciSt.
sentences.zh: 让我印象深刻的是，你说你准备就自己说过的一些话向纽约警察局道歉，并撤回关于该部门是种族主义者的指控。

sentences.en: Given what you just said about the experiences you recollect, why issue that apology?
sentences.zh: 鉴于你刚才提到的那些经历，为什么要发表那样的道歉？

sentences.en: And what would the apology even be?
sentences.zh: 而且，那样的道歉究竟是什么样的？

sentences.en: The issuing of it is to reckon with the fact that it's language that I'm applying to officers when, in fact, what I'm speaking about are specific practices.
sentences.zh: 发表道歉是为了正视这样一个事实：我所使用的语言针对的是警员，而实际上，我所谈论的是具体的做法。

sentences.en: And when I've met officers, not only over the course of being an assembly person, but also running for mayor, understanding that behind every caricature, behind every headline
sentences.zh: 当我见到警员时，不仅是在担任议员期间，也是在竞选市长期间，我意识到在每一个刻板印象、每一条新闻标题背后，

sentences.en: is a New Yorker trying to do their beSt.
sentences.zh: 都是一位正在尽其所能的纽约人。

sentences.en: And those meetings, those conversations, those are some of the ones I've appreciated the most, where I've shared an apology for the language that I've used and a desire to continue
sentences.zh: 而那些会面、那些对话，是我最珍视的时刻之一，在那里，我为自己所用的语言表达了歉意，并表达了继续

sentences.en: to fulfill those same ideals of safety and of justice and to do so together.
sentences.zh: 践行安全与正义的共同理想，并携手实现这一目标的愿望。

sentences.en: Are you apologizing for the language or for the thinking behind it?
sentences.zh: 你是在为语言道歉，还是为语言背后的思想道歉？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I'm not trying to be academic about this, but do you still think that the NYPD as an institution is racist?
sentences.zh: 我不是想在这儿咬文嚼字，但你是否仍然认为纽约警察局作为一个机构是种族主义的？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: And what I'm apologizing is for the language that I've used and also doing so as someone who is clear eyed about the necessity of still fulfilling those two things.
sentences.zh: 我道歉是因为我所使用的语言，同时也因为我作为一个清醒的人，明白仍有必要实现那两件事。

sentences.en: Let me turn to the rest of your outreach, which has been really striking.
sentences.zh: 让我转谈谈你其余的联络工作，这真的很引人注目。

sentences.en: I mean, let's turn to developers and to, frankly, the super rich in New York and business leaders.
sentences.zh: 我是说，让我们谈谈开发商，坦率地说，还有纽约的超级富豪和商界领袖。

sentences.en: You've been openly skeptical of the role of developers, for example.
sentences.zh: 例如，你一直公开质疑开发商的角色。

sentences.en: You have said you don't think billionaires should exist last night at your rally.
sentences.zh: 昨晚在集会上，你说你不认为亿万富翁应该存在。

sentences.en: You said that your movement is an existential threat to billionaires.
sentences.zh: 你说你的运动对亿万富翁构成了生存威胁。

sentences.en: Who think that they can buy an election?
sentences.zh: 那些认为自己可以买通选举的人？

sentences.en: Full quote.
sentences.zh: 引用全文。

sentences.en: How do you think they can buy an election?
sentences.zh: 你认为他们怎么能买通选举？

sentences.en: You got to fill the—you're right.
sentences.zh: 你得把——你说得对。

sentences.en: It's a podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 这是个播客。

sentences.en: You can't do the elipses.
sentences.zh: 你不能用省略号。

sentences.en: You got to accurately—that's what I wrote down.
sentences.zh: 你得准确地——那是我写下来的。

sentences.en: Maybe I missed the full sense.
sentences.zh: 也许我没领会完整的意思。

sentences.en: And you would like to increase taxes on those, making over a million dollars a year to pay for things like the three big promises we're talking about.
sentences.zh: 你希望对那些年收入超过一百万美元的人增税，以支付我们谈到的那三项重大承诺。

sentences.en: By 2%.
sentences.zh: 增加2%。

sentences.en: And yet, you're meeting with many of these people at their offices, at their homes in some cases.
sentences.zh: 然而，你却在他们的办公室，甚至在某些情况下在他们家里与这些人会面。

sentences.en: What have you said to those leaders in your meetings with them?
sentences.zh: 在与这些领导人的会面中，你对他们说了什么？

sentences.en: And what have they said to you?
sentences.zh: 他们又对你说了什么？

sentences.en: I've said many of the same things that I'm saying at these rallies, out on the street,
sentences.zh: 我说了许多我在集会上、在街头所说的话，

sentences.en: in these conversations, which is that I continue to believe that two of the most straightforward
sentences.zh: 在这些对话中，我始终认为，筹集收入、为我们的负担能力议程提供重要资金以及需要让城市免受特朗普影响的

sentences.en: and productive ways to raise revenue, to fund a significant part of our affordability agenda and the need to Trump-proof the city, are by, as you said—
sentences.zh: 最直接、最有效的方式，正如你所说——

sentences.en: Trump-proof.
sentences.zh: 免受特朗普影响。

sentences.en: We'll get back to that.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后再谈这个。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Are by increasing personal income taxes on the top 1% of New Yorkers.
sentences.zh: 就是对收入最高1%的纽约人增加个人所得税。

sentences.en: New Yorkers will make a million dollars a year or more by 2% and by increasing the state's top corporate tax rate from 7.25% to match that of New Jersey, 11.5%.
sentences.zh: 年收入一百万美元或以上的纽约人将增加2%的税，并将该州的最高企业税率从7.25%提高到与新泽西州持平的11.5%。

sentences.en: The socialist utopia of New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 新泽西州的社会主义乌托邦。

sentences.en: The socialist utopia of New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 新泽西州的社会主义乌托邦。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You were joking about that, just to be clear.
sentences.zh: 说清楚点，你刚才是在开玩笑。

sentences.en: And what I've appreciated about these conversations is that everyone knows exactly where I stand on these fiscal policies.
sentences.zh: 我所珍视的是，在这些对话中，每个人都清楚我在这些财政政策上的立场。

sentences.en: And I'm looking to have a conversation both about why I believe in these fiscal policies,
sentences.zh: 我希望就我为何相信这些财政政策进行对话，

sentences.en: but also that a disagreement on those policies should not preclude us from looking for agreements elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 同时也认为，在这些政策上的分歧不应妨碍我们在其他方面寻求共识。

sentences.en: I mean, it feels like what you're saying to these business leaders is, look, I'm going to be making changes to the system, but I'm not turning New York City, the center of American
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你对这些商界领袖说的话听起来像是：看，我会对体制进行改革，但我不会把美国资本主义的中心——纽约市，

sentences.en: capitalism, into a socialist utopia, if I'm kind of hearing you correctly.
sentences.zh: 变成一个社会主义乌托邦，如果我没听错的话。

sentences.en: But let me just get specific about a particular policy, and I want to understand your fidelity to it.
sentences.zh: 但让我具体谈谈某项政策，我想了解你对它的忠诚度。

sentences.en: The idea of what is being called a millionaire's tax, 2% tax on income over a million dollars,
sentences.zh: 所谓“百万富翁税”的想法，即对超过一百万美元的收入征收2%的税，

sentences.en: which feels very central to your agenda, felt very integral to the campaign and the primary.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是你议程的核心，也是竞选和初选不可或缺的一部分。

sentences.en: Since the primary, my sense, please correct me if I'm wrong, is that you've expressed an openness, and I don't know if this flowed from your conversations with business leaders,
sentences.zh: 初选之后，我的感觉是——如果我说错了请纠正我——你表达了一种开放态度，我不知道这是否源于你与商界领袖的对话，

sentences.en: to fund your agenda outside of that kind of a tax.
sentences.zh: 即通过那种税收以外的方式来资助你的议程。

sentences.en: And you know this, and our listeners may not as well.
sentences.zh: 你知道这一点，而我们的听众可能不知道。

sentences.en: Well, New York and New York City are funky.
sentences.zh: 嗯，纽约州和纽约市的情况很特殊。

sentences.en: The governor and the state legislature control all taxes but property tax, and the two taxes you just mentioned therefore require the participation of the governor, who says she
sentences.zh: 州长和州议会控制着除房产税以外的所有税种，因此你刚才提到的两种税都需要州长的参与，而她说她

sentences.en: does not want to participate in these so far, and the state legislature.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止不想参与其中，还需要州议会的参与。

sentences.en: So you seem to now be saying it doesn't necessarily matter where the money comes from.
sentences.zh: 所以你现在似乎在说，钱从哪里来并不一定重要。

sentences.en: But for democratic socialists and for this agenda that you are an avatar of, isn't taxing the rich more, as a principle, important?
sentences.zh: 但对于民主社会主义者和你所代表的这一议程来说，从原则上讲，对富人征收更多税不是更重要吗？

sentences.en: Isn't the method here important?
sentences.zh: 这里的方法不重要吗？

sentences.en: Or are you being more pragmatic about it?
sentences.zh: 还是说你在这方面变得更务实了？

sentences.en: If you look at the chronology of the campaign, the first thing we speak about is what we are looking to fund.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看竞选的时间表，我们首先谈论的是我们想要资助什么。

sentences.en: October 23rd, when we launched the campaign, we talk about freezing the rent for rent-stabilized tenants, making buses fast and free, delivering universal child care.
sentences.zh: 10月23日，当我们启动竞选活动时，我们谈到了冻结租金稳定租户的租金，让公交车变得快捷免费，提供全民托儿服务。

sentences.en: The most important thing is always the policies themselves.
sentences.zh: 最重要的事情永远是政策本身。

sentences.en: And I continue to believe as a principle that it's important to have a fair system of taxation.
sentences.zh: 我始终坚持认为，拥有一个公平的税收体系在原则上很重要。

sentences.en: And I do not think the one that we have is an example of that.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我们现有的体系并非如此。

sentences.en: And to me, it is always and has always been the case that far more important than the means by which you fund something is the fact that you are in fact funding it.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，资助某件事的事实远比资助的方式重要得多，这一点一直如此，将来也是如此。

sentences.en: And so I still think that these two tax proposals are the most straightforward and productive ways to do so.
sentences.zh: 所以我仍然认为这两个税收提案是实现这一目标最直接、最有效的方式。

sentences.en: There are other revenue proposals that also exist that have been put forward.
sentences.zh: 还有其他已经提出的收入提案。

sentences.en: There's also the fact that I have sat in Albany year after year.
sentences.zh: 还有一个事实是，我年复一年地坐在奥尔巴尼。

sentences.en: And watched.
sentences.zh: 看着。

sentences.en: And watched, as we've been told, the receipts we estimated, they're actually going to be bigger this year than we thought.
sentences.zh: 看着，正如我们被告知的那样，我们估计的收入，今年实际上会比我们预想的要多。

sentences.en: And if there is a proposal that the $4 billion we would raise from one of these taxes from the personal income tax increase can be found elsewhere, I'm not going to fight to bring
sentences.zh: 如果有一个提案能从其他地方找到我们从这些税收之一（个人所得税增加）中筹集的40亿美元，我不会为了回到我最初建议的方式而抗争。

sentences.en: it back to the original means that I suggested.
sentences.zh: 我会为了确保这40亿美元被用于资助全民托儿服务的重要部分而抗争。

sentences.en: I'm going to fight to ensure that that $4 billion is then used to fund a significant portion of universal child care.
sentences.zh: 我会为了确保这40亿美元被用于资助全民托儿服务的重要部分而抗争。

sentences.en: And I think that always has to be what drives us, that we are funding the affordability agenda, not the question of how.
sentences.zh: 我认为这必须始终是我们前进的动力，即我们是在资助负担能力议程，而不是纠结于方式问题。

sentences.en: And I do believe these are the two most straightforward ways to do so.
sentences.zh: 而且我确实认为这是实现这一目标最直接的两种方式。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So the method does matter, but it doesn't have to be this method that gets there.
sentences.zh: 所以方法确实重要，但不一定非得是这种方法才能达到目的。

sentences.en: I mean, it does strike me that you're already starting to confront some of the challenges
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这确实让我觉得你已经开始面对一些挑战了，

sentences.en: that when you talk about Cuomo, you found distasteful, which is, you know, you're dealing with a Democratic governor who isn't on the same page with you.
sentences.zh: 当你谈到科莫时，你觉得这些挑战令人反感，也就是说，你在和一个与你意见不合的民主党州长打交道。

sentences.en: And that's an immediate kind of like old versus DSA, Momdani.
sentences.zh: 这是一种直接的“旧势力对阵DSA（美国民主社会主义者）”的局面，Momdani。

sentences.en: I would contrast Governor Hochul with Governor Cuomo in that Cuomo almost made it his mission to go to war with New York City.
sentences.zh: 我会将霍楚尔州长与科莫州长进行对比，因为科莫几乎把与纽约市开战当作了自己的使命。

sentences.en: He would cut so much of what he could find in what the state was funding across these five boroughs.
sentences.zh: 他会削减他在五个行政区内州政府资助的所有他能找到的项目。

sentences.en: And when Bill de Blasio ran on a promise of universal pre-K and the necessity of working
sentences.zh: 当白思豪竞选时承诺全民学前班，并强调与奥尔巴尼合作寻找该项目资金的必要性时，

sentences.en: with Albany to find the funding for that program, Governor Cuomo was one of the chief obstacles to it.
sentences.zh: 科莫州长是主要的障碍之一。

sentences.en: And what I've found is that though Governor Hochul and I have a disagreement as to the necessity
sentences.zh: 我发现，尽管霍楚尔州长和我对是否有必要

sentences.en: of taxing the wealthiest New Yorkers, the most profitable corporations, we have a clear agreement on the importance of universal child care.
sentences.zh: 向最富有的纽约人和利润最高的公司征税存在分歧，但我们在全民托儿服务的重要性上达成了明确共识。

sentences.en: And to me, that is the kind of agreement that was missing under the previous leader of the state, because so often he was the obstacle to any affirmative vision of what government
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这就是前任州领导下所缺失的那种共识，因为他经常是政府能为劳动人民做些什么的任何积极愿景的障碍。

sentences.en: could be doing for working people.
sentences.zh: 政府能为劳动人民做些什么的任何积极愿景的障碍。

sentences.en: Then there's the Jewish community.
sentences.zh: 接下来是犹太社区。

sentences.en: As we kind of tick through the folks that you have been meeting with, then you end up in rooms where people have been challenging you directly, sometimes emotionally, is my sense.
sentences.zh: 当我们盘点你一直在会见的人时，你会发现自己身处一些房间，人们直接挑战你，有时甚至带有情绪，我是这么感觉的。

sentences.en: I'm thinking about Dr. Albert Bourla, CEO of Pfizer.
sentences.zh: 我想到的是辉瑞公司的首席执行官Albert Bourla博士。

sentences.en: Our colleagues reported on your conversation with him.
sentences.zh: 我们的同事报道了你与他的谈话。

sentences.en: He's the son of Holocaust survivors.
sentences.zh: 他是大屠杀幸存者的儿子。

sentences.en: And he pleads with you to stop calling what's been happening in Gaza up until now, there's now a ceasefire, a genocide, which is what you call it.
sentences.zh: 他恳求你停止将加沙至今发生的事情——现在已经停火了——称为种族灭绝，而这正是你的称呼。

sentences.en: And he pushed for you to condemn this phrase, globalize the Intifada, because in his mind, it raises a specter of violence against Jews.
sentences.zh: 他敦促你谴责“全球化起义”这个短语，因为在他看来，这引发了针对犹太人的暴力阴影。

sentences.en: My sense is that in these conversations, you've given some ground on things like globalize the Intifada, not on genocide.
sentences.zh: 我的感觉是，在这些对话中，你在“全球化起义”之类的事情上做出了一些让步，但在种族灭绝问题上没有。

sentences.en: And I wonder what you've come to understand about the perspective of people like
sentences.zh: 我想知道你对像Bourla博士这样的人以及纽约犹太人普遍的观点有了什么了解，他们也许和警察一样，

sentences.en: Dr. Bourla and Jews in general in New York, who are in the same way, perhaps, that police were
sentences.zh: 正在努力应对你对他们的评价，而他们也在努力应对你谈论以色列的方式。

sentences.en: grappling with what you were saying about them grappling with the way you talk about Israel.
sentences.zh: 正在努力应对你谈论以色列的方式。

sentences.en: I would distinguish one piece in that my use of the term genocide is not
sentences.zh: 我会区分一点，即我使用“种族灭绝”这个词并不是

sentences.en: a personal opinion.
sentences.zh: 个人观点。

sentences.en: Rather, it's a reflection of findings by institutions, even of genocide scholars themselves, institutions like the United Nations.
sentences.zh: 相反，它是对各机构，甚至是种族灭绝学者本身，以及联合国等机构调查结果的反映。

sentences.en: And it is a word that reflects what has been happening in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 这是一个反映加沙正在发生什么情况的词。

sentences.en: And these conversations that I've been having, both since the primary, but also, frankly, prior to the primary, have been illuminating for me in both having an opportunity
sentences.zh: 我一直在进行的这些对话，无论是初选以来，还是坦率地说，在初选之前，都让我大开眼界，因为我有机会

sentences.en: to meet many New Yorkers, especially Jewish New Yorkers, for whom their only impression of me was through a caricature.
sentences.zh: 见到许多纽约人，特别是犹太裔纽约人，他们对我唯一的印象是通过刻板印象得来的。

sentences.en: Whether it be a caricature- What was that caricature, do you think?
sentences.zh: 无论是刻板印象——你认为那是什么样的刻板印象？

sentences.en: Well, you know, I had the distinct pleasure of having around $30 million spent against me in the primary.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，在初选中，我有幸被投入了大约3000万美元来反对我。

sentences.en: And it was $30 million that was spent in mailers, in TV ads.
sentences.zh: 那是3000万美元，花在了邮寄广告和电视广告上。

sentences.en: I saw some of those mailers.
sentences.zh: 我看到过其中一些邮寄广告。

sentences.en: They were, some of them were rather vivid.
sentences.zh: 它们，其中一些相当生动。

sentences.en: There was a mailer sent by Andrew Cuomo's Super PAC that artificially lengthened my beard.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁·科莫的超级政治行动委员会寄出了一份邮寄广告，人为地加长了我的胡子。

sentences.en: And there was another mailer sent by another candidate.
sentences.zh: 还有另一位候选人寄出的另一份邮寄广告。

sentences.en: So that you were more menacingly something.
sentences.zh: 让你看起来更具威胁性。

sentences.en: And it specifically chose to feature a photo of me in Akurta.
sentences.zh: 它特意选择了一张我穿着库尔塔长衫的照片。

sentences.en: And there was another mailer sent by another candidate that implied I was going to kill Jewish New Yorkers.
sentences.zh: 还有另一位候选人寄出的另一份邮寄广告，暗示我要杀害犹太裔纽约人。

sentences.en: Part of the earlier conversation we were having about the Democratic Party, these are mailers that were sent in a
sentences.zh: 我们之前关于民主党的对话的一部分，这些都是在民主党初选中寄出的邮寄广告。

sentences.zh: 真正使其成为法律的是我们通过法院系统进行诉讼。

sentences.en: And what we've seen is a approach in California where the attorney general, the mayor of LA,
sentences.zh: 我们看到加利福尼亚州采取了一种方法，总检察长、洛杉矶市长、

sentences.en: the governor of the state came together to file a lawsuit that where a federal judge recently found in their favor, the deployment of the National Guard was illegal.
sentences.zh: 州长联合提起诉讼，联邦法官最近做出了有利于他们的裁决，部署国民警卫队是非法的。

sentences.en: And also an attorney general who found that for every dollar that they spent on legal fees, they were able to recover more than
sentences.zh: 还有一位总检察长发现，他们每花一美元的法律费用，就能收回超过

sentences.en: 30,000 in federal funds that would have otherwise been stripped of them.
sentences.zh: 3万美元的联邦资金，否则这些资金本会被剥夺。

sentences.en: Ultimately, a major reason why Trump might intervene in New York would be part of an ICE campaign to round up and deport undocumented immigrants.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，特朗普可能干预纽约的一个主要原因将是ICE（移民及海关执法局）围捕和驱逐无证移民行动的一部分。

sentences.en: That's been an argument, pretense he's made in several places where the National Guard eventually comes.
sentences.zh: 这已经成为他在几个地方提出的论点和借口，国民警卫队最终会出现在那里。

sentences.en: There are an estimated
sentences.zh: 据估计，

sentences.en: 400,000 undocumented immigrants in New York.
sentences.zh: 纽约有40万无证移民。

sentences.en: And as you found as you ran this primary that was so successful, and you met with many Trump-supporting New Yorkers who have turned around and supported
sentences.zh: 正如你在这次非常成功的初选中所发现的那样，你遇到了许多转而支持你的特朗普支持者，

sentences.en: you, is that their viewpoint on these issues is complicated.
sentences.zh: 他们的观点在这些问题上很复杂。

sentences.en: And many of them have serious objections to the level of undocumented immigration in a place like New York City.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人对纽约市这类地方的无证移民水平有严重的反对意见。

sentences.en: But I don't hear from your campaign that you're going to be participating in any Trump-led effort to detain, deport undocumented immigrants.
sentences.zh: 但我没有听到你的竞选团队说你要参与任何特朗普领导的拘留、驱逐无证移民的行动。

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不呢？

sentences.en: I'm not looking to assist Donald Trump in his attempt to fulfill his campaign promise to create the single largest deportation force in American history.
sentences.zh: 我不想协助唐纳德·特朗普实现他竞选时承诺的创建美国历史上最大规模驱逐部队的计划。

sentences.en: I'm not looking to do so because...
sentences.zh: 我不想这样做是因为……

sentences.en: Even if you know that some of your, maybe perhaps many of your supporters do want illegal immigration to be treated differently than it has.
sentences.zh: 即使你知道你的一些，甚至可能是许多支持者确实希望非法移民问题能得到与以往不同的处理。

sentences.en: What I've heard from my supporters and what I've heard from New Yorkers, frankly, is a desire for dignity.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，我从我的支持者和纽约人那里听到的是对尊严的渴望。

sentences.en: And in looking at what ICE's presence has been in New York City, what it has meant for our city, seeing at the very least an absence of that.
sentences.zh: 看看ICE在纽约市的存在，它对我们城市意味着什么，至少能看到这种尊严的缺失。

sentences.en: And in fact, an attack, not only on the question of dignity, but on the very fabric of the city, right, where there are New Yorkers I know of
sentences.zh: 事实上，这不仅是对尊严问题的攻击，更是对城市肌理的攻击，你知道，我认识一些纽约人，

sentences.en: who took down the numbers on every apartment on their floor so that ICE wouldn't know where anyone lived.
sentences.zh: 他们撕掉了公寓楼层上的门牌号，这样ICE就不会知道谁住在哪里。

sentences.en: I spoke to a Dominican barbershop owner in Harlem who told me that all of his barbers have legal status and they are terrified of coming to work.
sentences.zh: 我曾与哈莱姆区一位多米尼加理发店老板交谈，他告诉我他所有的理发师都有合法身份，但他们害怕来上班。

sentences.en: A general sense of the hollowing out of the immigrant hubs of this city.
sentences.zh: 这是一种这座城市移民中心被掏空的普遍感觉。

sentences.en: And no, I'm not going to help Donald Trump in doing so.
sentences.zh: 不，我不会协助唐纳德·特朗普做这些事。

sentences.en: I'm in fact going to fight Donald Trump when he looks to tear families apart.
sentences.zh: 事实上，当他试图拆散家庭时，我会反抗唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: And I'm going to do so because I know what the stakes are.
sentences.zh: 我会这样做，因为我知道利害关系是什么。

sentences.en: When he detains a six-year-old girl from Queens and deports her,
sentences.zh: 当他拘留并驱逐一名来自皇后区的六岁女孩时，

sentences.en: I know that her principal is writing a letter to ICE saying, please don't do this.
sentences.zh: 我知道她的校长会写信给ICE说，请不要这样做。

sentences.en: I mean, here you're saying the method can't be separated from the goal and you're rejecting the method because you're rejecting the goal.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你在这里说方法不能与目标分开，你拒绝这种方法是因为你拒绝这个目标。

sentences.en: I mean, that's right there.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就是这样。

sentences.en: I think also I reject the goal.
sentences.zh: 我认为我也拒绝这个目标。

sentences.en: It's not just the manner in which this detention is happening.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是这种拘留发生的方式问题。

sentences.en: It's the fact that the goal here is cruelty.
sentences.zh: 事实是，这里的目标就是残忍。

sentences.en: The goal is to rip these families apart.
sentences.zh: 目标是拆散这些家庭。

sentences.en: And the goal is to attack so much of what is the foundation of the city as an immigrant city.
sentences.zh: 目标是攻击这座作为移民城市之基石的很大一部分。

sentences.en: Would you ever meet with President Trump in the hope that you could defang this person,
sentences.zh: 你是否会与特朗普总统会面，希望你能消除这个人的敌意，

sentences.en: this president, who may have ill will toward you, but frankly doesn't really know you at all?
sentences.zh: 这位总统，他可能对你有恶意，但坦率地说，他根本不了解你？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对会。

sentences.en: I will meet with President Trump.
sentences.zh: 我会与特朗普总统会面。

sentences.en: I think it's incumbent upon any mayor of this city to meet with the president of the country.
sentences.zh: 我认为这座城市的任何市长都有责任与国家总统会面。

sentences.en: What I won't do is work with President Trump at the expense of this city.
sentences.zh: 我不会做的是以牺牲这座城市为代价与特朗普总统合作。

sentences.en: That's the critique that I've made of Andrew Cuomo and of Eric Adams is that their conversations with Trump have more to do with themselves than to do with the people of the city.
sentences.zh: 我对安德鲁·科莫和埃里克·亚当斯的批评在于，他们与特朗普的对话更多是出于自身利益，而非为了这座城市的人民。

sentences.en: It's not that they're talking to him.
sentences.zh: 并不是说他们不该与他对话。

sentences.en: It's that who are they talking to him about?
sentences.zh: 而是他们对话的内容究竟是为了谁？

sentences.en: I want to end this conversation on the movement that you've quite clearly created in New York City.
sentences.zh: 我想结束关于你显然已经在纽约市发起的这场运动的讨论。

sentences.en: It's a movement we saw on vivid display last night that argues that the democratic politics of
sentences.zh: 昨晚我们清晰地看到了这场运动，它主张现代时代的民主政治，

sentences.en: the modern era, the old formulas, that word resonated last night when you said it, have failed, and that you can replace it with something new.
sentences.zh: 那些旧有的公式——昨晚你提到这个词时引起了共鸣——已经失败了，而你可以用全新的事物来取代它。

sentences.en: And in your speech at this rally we all went to, you likened it to the great movements of American history, civil rights movement,
sentences.zh: 在我们参加的那场集会上，你在演讲中将其比作美国历史上的伟大运动，比如民权运动，

sentences.en: the movement for labor rights that created the modern weekend where workers can take a break, the New Deal, and the birth of a social safety net.
sentences.zh: 创造了现代周末让工人得以休息的劳工权利运动，新政，以及社会安全网的诞生。

sentences.en: That sets expectations pretty high.
sentences.zh: 这把期望值定得相当高。

sentences.en: I'm not sure can get much higher.
sentences.zh: 我不确定还能高到哪里去。

sentences.en: And there's nobility in that and there's real risk in that.
sentences.zh: 这其中既有崇高之处，也存在真正的风险。

sentences.en: And so do you worry
sentences.zh: 那么你是否担心

sentences.en: that it will be hard to deliver on those expectations?
sentences.zh: 要实现这些期望会很困难？

sentences.en: You're pretty new to management on this scale.
sentences.zh: 你在这个规模的管理工作上还是个新手。

sentences.en: And if it's impossible or even really difficult to deliver, what does it do to this movement?
sentences.zh: 如果实现这些目标是不可能的，甚至是非常困难的，这对这场运动意味着什么？

sentences.en: I'm glad I won't have to answer the hypothetical because I fully intend to deliver.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴不必回答这个假设性问题，因为我完全打算实现这些目标。

sentences.en: And we have to.
sentences.zh: 而且我们必须做到。

sentences.en: We came to these policies, to these commitments, not because of a poll that we commissioned or a consultant that we sat with.
sentences.zh: 我们提出这些政策和承诺，并非因为我们委托了民调，也不是因为我们咨询了顾问。

sentences.en: In fact, the polls said that you should focus on public safety.
sentences.zh: 事实上，民调显示你应该关注公共安全。

sentences.en: The polls also had me tied with someone else.
sentences.zh: 民调还显示我和其他人打成平手。

sentences.en: Literally.
sentences.zh: 字面意义上的。

sentences.en: Literally anybody else.
sentences.zh: 字面意义上和任何其他人。

sentences.en: And I beat that guy.
sentences.zh: 但我还是赢了那个人。

sentences.en: But I say this to say that it's New Yorkers who told us it was housing.
sentences.zh: 我这么说是因为，是纽约人告诉我们重点是住房问题。

sentences.en: It's New Yorkers who told us it was childcare.
sentences.zh: 是纽约人告诉我们重点是托儿服务。

sentences.en: It's New Yorkers who told us it was the slowest bosses in America.
sentences.zh: 是纽约人告诉我们重点是美国最慢的公交系统。

sentences.en: And the necessity of fulfilling these commitments are also to ensure that those New Yorkers stay New Yorkers.
sentences.zh: 而履行这些承诺的必要性，也是为了确保这些纽约人能继续留在纽约。

sentences.en: They continue to see themselves in the city.
sentences.zh: 让他们继续在这座城市中找到自己的位置。

sentences.en: And the only way we can do so is if they see their struggles in our politics.
sentences.zh: 而我们能做到这一点的唯一方法，就是让他们在我们的政治中看到他们所面临的挣扎。

sentences.en: And there are many politicians who will tell you that the best life could ever be is the one that you're living in right now.
sentences.zh: 有很多政客会告诉你，你现在过的生活就是你能拥有的最好的生活。

sentences.en: And those are also the ones who have paved the way for the politics we've seen of
sentences.zh: 而这些人也正是为我们所见的唐纳德·特朗普式的政治铺平道路的人，

sentences.en: Donald Trump, because you have to be able to reckon with the material needs of working people and the fact that so many of them are going unmet.
sentences.zh: 因为你必须能够正视劳动人民的物质需求，以及他们中有太多人的需求尚未得到满足的事实。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Sounds like you're saying, I know what I believe.
sentences.zh: 听起来你是在说，我知道我的信仰是什么。

sentences.en: I'm not going to compromise on my values.
sentences.zh: 我不会在我的价值观上妥协。

sentences.en: And my administration will not compromise on my values.
sentences.zh: 我的政府也不会在我的价值观上妥协。

sentences.en: And that will be enough.
sentences.zh: 这就足够了。

sentences.en: This is like my translator.
sentences.zh: 这就像我的翻译官一样。

sentences.en: Perhaps it will be enough.
sentences.zh: 也许这就足够了。

sentences.en: Assemblyman, Zoran,
sentences.zh: 州议员，佐兰，

sentences.en: Mr. Mondani, thank you very much for your time.
sentences.zh: 蒙达尼先生，非常感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: It's a pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: Good luck to you.
sentences.zh: 祝你好运。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Same to you.
sentences.zh: 也祝你一切顺利。

sentences.en: Oh, yes.
sentences.zh: 哦，好的。

sentences.en: We're doing a quick interview photo.
sentences.zh: 我们来拍一张采访照片。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.zh: 我们要来那种政客式的握手吗？

sentences.en: No, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不，不。

sentences.zh: 今晚晚些时候，佐兰·蒙达尼将参加市长竞选的首次大选辩论，

sentences.en: race, where he'll face off against Andrew Cuomo, now running as an independent, and Curtis Sliwa, a Republican.
sentences.zh: 届时他将面对以独立身份参选的安德鲁·科莫，以及共和党人柯蒂斯·斯利瓦。

sentences.zh: 辩论将于晚上7点开始。

sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，特朗普政府已秘密授权中央情报局在委内瑞拉采取秘密行动，

sentences.en: action in Venezuela, a major escalation in its campaign against the country's authoritarian leader, Nicolas Maduro.
sentences.zh: 这是其针对该国威权领导人尼古拉斯·马杜罗的行动的一次重大升级。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: military has already been destroying boats off Venezuela's coast that it claims are transporting drugs.
sentences.zh: 军方已经在委内瑞拉海岸摧毁了其声称用于运毒的船只。

sentences.en: And in private conversations, U.S.
sentences.zh: 而在私下谈话中，美国

sentences.en: officials are now making it clear that their end goal is to drive Maduro from power.
sentences.zh: 官员们现在明确表示，他们的最终目标是将马杜罗赶下台。

sentences.en: And in oral arguments on
sentences.zh: 在周三的口头辩论中，

sentences.zh: 最高法院的保守派多数似乎准备挑战《1965年投票权法案》的一项关键条款，
